name: Tabs
description: Tabbed content container with ARIA tablist semantics and keyboard navigation
designIntent: Tabs organize related content into switchable panels. Tabs manages the active tab, wires ARIA relationships, and uses roving tabindex so keyboard users move through tabs with arrow keys.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the active tab changes

examples.title: Basic tabs
examples.code:
<Tabs defaultValue="overview">
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTrigger value="overview">Overview</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="analytics">Analytics</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="overview">Overview panel</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="analytics">Analytics panel</TabsContent>
</Tabs>

examples.title: Controlled tabs
examples.code:
<Tabs value={tab} onValueChange={setTab}>
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTrigger value="one">One</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="two">Two</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="one">Panel one</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="two">Panel two</TabsContent>
</Tabs>

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Tabs for primary navigation
antiPatterns.explanation: Tabs switch content within a view. Use links or a navigation menu for moving between pages.

antiPatterns.title: Don't nest Tabs more than one level deep
antiPatterns.explanation: Nested tabs disorient users; use sections or accordions instead.

accessibility.userRequirements: Every trigger must have a matching panel

accessibility.implementation: Only the active tab is tabbable; arrow keys move between tabs

compositionRules.relationship: Wrap triggers in a TabsList for correct semantics
